# Refining prompts

Prompts you run on another prompt before using it: deepening the ask toward what an expert would actually do, instead of making it bigger.

Fill in the `[BRACKETS]` and paste a prompt into any assistant, with [about-me.md](../about-me.md) above it, or ask Claude to use it by name through the `prompt-library` skill.

| Prompt | Use when |
|---|---|
| [Deepen a prompt, don't enlarge it](deepen-not-bigger.md) | a prompt or task would get you a competent but shallow answer, and you want what a top professional in the field would do instead |

*This file is generated by `scripts/build.py` from the prompts' frontmatter.*
